issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-6882](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-6882)
### Description

As part of https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/17038, we made the OpenTable call async.

Due to a fundamental mistake in my commit, the `CreateInitialSysCatalogSnapshot` test in gcc11 build failed - https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/commit/44c7e12f0fe0287f136aebf8c4f605f1bbc08073.

This failure only happened in gcc11 build possibly due to low chances of failure in `GetTableSchema`. Audit to see if any other tests can be added to test the code path a bit more.

body:
Note that we didn't backport the async OpenTable of YBClient. That is okay because it was a minor piece.

The main fix was to make `YBMetaDataCache::GetTable` async which was done in Sergei's fix. Post his fix, only the first thread would block while the other threads would register callback and get freed.

The async OpenTable of YBClient ensures that even the first thread doesn't get blocked. So it is ok to not backport it.
